about_the_game:
One day in the future, an explosion in a biotechnology laboratory in a certain city caused a chemical leak, triggering a rift in space-time. This leak led to drastic changes in the human world, causing many to mutate and acquire superpowers, becoming special beings known as "psychics." The cause of these superpowers lies deep within the rift, posing an unknown threat to humanity.

I am a researcher hired to investigate the results of a future genetic research experiment and was caught up in the explosion. A survivor of this disaster, I am eager to uncover the truth. To protect my home, I joined the city's labor union, desperate to find a team with special abilities to stop the unrest caused by the rift.

During my investigation, I connected with other psychics, sharing their powers and experiences. Meanwhile, as my mission progressed, various factions began to emerge. Some shared our goal of protecting their homeland, while others sought to master the true meaning of superpowers and use them as tools for world domination.

As the number of psychics increases dramatically, my teammates and I must not only fight the threat posed by psychics from various factions, but also unravel the mysteries of space-time rifts and potion leaks, and stop the conspiracy of unknown forces.

content_descriptors.notes: Character costumes in the game include bikinis, etc.
